reviewed_by: Codex focused review for provider request breakdown
reason: Direct provider chats now retain a content-free breakdown of the last outbound request, expose it in context status and the session inspector, and omit duplicate built-in tool descriptions from final synthesis. The selected Python tests cover request accounting, durable chat status, and loaded versus unloaded deferred tools. The component test covers readable breakdown details. One production real-Core LAN journey covers provider dispatch, persistence, inspector display, reload, and desktop/mobile browser geometry.
exclusions: No full suite approval was given. Other provider adapters and harness-owned context are unchanged. Native tests are unrelated. The real-Core journey uses a local model stub, not a paid cloud provider. Mobile profiles are emulated; no physical device is available. The selected journey does not exercise tool execution in the browser because the Python tool-loop tests cover request construction and synthesis.
